## About
Damage Control Auto Body is a family owned and operated shop on Joliet Rd in McCook. Our main specialty is auto body work and painting, and we also offer full interior and exterior detailing.
We built this shop with your comfort and peace of mind first. When your vehicle is with us, you can rest easy knowing it will be repaired correctly, safely and in an efficient amount of time. Every job goes through our checkpoints before it leaves the building.
Customers rate us 4.6 on Google from 83 reviews. Reviewers have mentioned Jeff, and Jeremy and his crew, by name.

## Services
- Paint & Collision Repair: Body work and painting is our main specialty.
- Interior / Exterior Basic Package: Our basic interior and exterior detail, with hand wash, window cleaning and wax outside, plus vacuuming and stain removal inside.
- Interior & Exterior Deluxe package: A deeper interior and exterior detail, estimated at 5+ hours.
- Ceramic Coatings: Available upon request.
- Paint Correction: Available upon request.
- Carpet & Upholstery Dye: Available upon request, along with seat and carpet removal.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Send us a message through the contact page letting us know what's going on with your vehicle, and we'll get back to you soon with a quote.

Q: Is your work covered?
A: Yes. All of our work has a lifetime warranty backed by PPG Paints and Damage Control Inc.

Q: How long does a detail take?
A: Our interior and exterior basic package is estimated at 2-4 hours. The deluxe package takes longer.
